data.one_liner: Animated GridViews and Wraps with drag-and-drop reordering and item animations.
data.what_it_does: Enables animated drag-and-drop reordering for various GridView types and Wrap widgets. Also provides smooth entrance, exit, and update animations for child items.
use_when: You need a reorderable GridView with smooth drag-and-drop animations.
You want animations when items are added, removed, or updated inside a grid or wrap.
avoid_when: You only need a standard single-list reorderable view (use Flutter's built-in ReorderableListView instead).
You are not using GridView or Wrap widgets.
strengths: Supports GridView, GridView.builder, and Wrap widgets.
Provides built-in automatic scrolling while dragging near edges.
Customizable animation configurations for insertions, removals, and feedback.
weaknesses: Requires unique keys for every child widget.
Careful setup of ScrollControllers is required depending on nesting.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need complex staggered layouts rather than standard grid or wrap reordering.
